correctness.rationale: The graph is unambiguously the 24 permutations with exactly one adjacent-position swap per edge (36 edges). ArXiv:2212.05871 Lemma 2.2 validates the closed-ball radius 3/2 to union-of-closed-neighborhoods formula. The self-contained verifier reconstructs all 36 size-6 facets and all 1230 nonempty faces; every listed one of 606 codimension-one matching pairs is unique, 502 are checked as consecutive elementary simplicial collapses, and all 4344 Hasse incidences are reversed/unchanged according to the pairs and exhaustively topologically sorted, proving acyclicity. One critical zero-cell and 17 critical two-cells imply an integral 17-sphere wedge via discrete Morse CW theory. Independently computed mod-two Čech boundary ranks and graph-distance-three Rips ranks confirm second Betti numbers 17 and 1. A finite exhaustive proof is claimed only for the specified graph and scale.

value.rationale: The 24-vertex permutohedron is a standard canonical Cayley/Coxeter graph, not a cherry-picked induced subgraph. Radius 3/2 probes a natural scale outside short-cycle recovery guarantees. An explicit integral homotopy classification for a pure five-dimensional nerve, its failure of shellability, and a substantial same-graph Čech–Rips homological separation (17 versus 1 over F2) are motivated invariants and supply structural benchmark information beyond numeric enumeration. No larger-family extension is claimed.
